AI Voice Agent (Calls) in Coimbatore: packages and prices

An AI phone agent that answers calls, qualifies leads, books appointments and follows up.

Quick answer

AI Voice Agent (Calls) from Vintorex Digital Solutions in Coimbatore starts at ₹39,999 for the Starter package and goes up to ₹1,79,999 for Premium, excluding 18% GST. Typical market prices run ₹75,000 to ₹3,50,000. Delivery: 2–10 weeks.

Overview

A voice agent that picks up every call, speaks naturally in English, Tamil or Hindi, answers from your approved information, books appointments and hands urgent calls to your team. It also makes reminder and follow-up calls, with consent and opt-out handled.

Ideal for

  • Clinics, salons and service firms that miss calls
  • Real-estate, education and finance teams that qualify many leads
  • Businesses that need reminders and follow-ups at scale
